decisions.story_title: D-Link DIR-600L firmware 2.17b02 HNAP handler stack buffer overflow CVE-2026-129354 (CVSS 10.0)
decisions.reason: Distinct real CVE, not the sibling CVE-2026-129353 (authentication.cgi): CVE-2026-129354 is a stack-based buffer overflow in hnap_main of htdocs/cgibin (HNAP Handler) in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17b02, confirmed on VulDB 437417, CVE.org and Strix with public exploit code, CVSS 10, no fixed version. Verified via web search against those primary records.

CVE-2026-129354.evidence: Radar post and VulDB record flag public exploit code / PoC maturity; no in-the-wild exploitation, KEV listing or campaign reported.
